sentence: This project works toward finding the causes of, and treatments for, genetic disease in people.
This project studies how cerebral small vessel disease and Alzheimer’s Disease pathology affect each other in the medial temporal lobe.
This project provides technical support for medical device commercialization and biomedical engineering by managing a roster of service providers and vendors.
This project improves computational and experimental methods that check for unintended effects of gene editing therapies, while accounting for human genetic diversity.
This project studies the job of one poorly understood protein that helps mammalian cells respond to viral infection.
This project studies how synthetic coolants in vaping products change the abuse liability of nicotine and behaviors linked to starting use.
This project studies what information the brain sends to the nerve cord to control walking.
This project builds a deep learning pipeline that speeds up flow MRI scans and automates hemodynamic analysis for patients with bicuspid aortic valve.
This project develops a non-invasive imaging strategy that could show early which patients with melanoma and renal cell carcinoma will respond to immunotherapy.
This project develops a method that uses routine electronic health data and artificial intelligence to predict which patients may get postoperative delirium.
This project tries to find out how disease-linked mutations change the structure and function of the delta-2 receptor.
This project studies how host genetics and the microbiome shape feeding behavior and food preferences in Drosophila.
This project studies how connections from the infralimbic prefrontal cortex to the hypothalamus in male and female rodents affect cardiovascular susceptibility to stress.
This project builds a mouse model with an epitope-tagged estrogen receptor beta to make that receptor easier to detect and study in disease.
This project develops smaller lighter miniaturized fluorescent microscopes for live imaging of neural activity in freely moving animals and refines methods that make tissue transparent.
This project studies how the separate nuclei inside heart muscle cells combine in a nuclear code that shapes the cell and its resistance to stress.
This project studies water, sediment and soil samples to find pathogen hotspots and how pathogens grow, spread and show diversity.
This project tries to find out how a tumor suppressor takes part in chronic lung allograft dysfunction.
This project develops instruments and methods that bring more molecular detail to tissue tests used to diagnose cancer.
